baseline.method: ASLtk multi-delay Buxton fit, unmodified upstream raw parameters with explicit unit conversion

signal_relative_l2_definition: L2 norm of predicted-minus-observed magnetization divided by observation L2 norm, over all acquired delays and fixed brain mask
numeric_tolerance_provenance: Independent full upstream reruns identical; nonzero 1e-6 dynamic-range tolerance covers float32 parameter storage and independent backend roundoff; all arrays compared without alignment.
